title: Magnolia Cruis'n and Sail'n | KEY.co
description_expanded: Cruis'n and Sail'n, located in Seacrest Beach, FL, is a stunning three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home designed for luxurious beachside living. Nestled within the charming Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, this retreat offers guests the ultimate blend of comfort and convenience. The expansive living area boasts a 65" TV, perfect for family movie nights, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar ensures every meal is a delight. Each bedroom is a haven of relaxation, featuring king beds and en suite bathrooms with the added luxury of large-screen TVs. The bunk room and additional built-in bunk beds on the main level provide fun and cozy sleeping arrangements for younger guests. The location is equally captivating, with convenient beach access at Gulf Lakes, ensuring you’re never far from the pristine, sun-drenched shores that define the 30A experience. After a day at the beach, the resort-style pool offers a refreshing retreat amidst the natural wooded beauty of the community. With a golf cart included, exploring the scenic surroundings is a breeze. Magnolia Cottages by the Sea is not just a place to stay but a destination that promises relaxation and rejuvenation, making it the perfect backdrop for unforgettable family memories.
